eligibility.evidence: Introduction and Methods: three of four instruments (AHS, DSS, SCS) are self-report scales and fail E2, but the Triadic Categorization Task is a behavioural categorisation task citing Talhelm et al. 2014 (refs 12-13), so E2 passes on that task alone. GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 are the subjects; new responses and t-tests reported (Table 1).

A.title: The Cultural Psychology of Large Language Models: Is ChatGPT a Holistic or Analytic Thinker?

paradigms.name: Triadic Categorization Task (holistic vs analytic categorisation, 20-item version, 10 scored items)
paradigms.source_paper: Talhelm et al. 2014; Dong et al. 2019

D.population: Chinese provinces (Talhelm et al. 2014 provincial data)
D.metric: mean proportion of holistic (relation-based) matches per province

E.headline: ChatGPT leans to Eastern holistic thinking on cognitive-process measures (AHS, TCT) but not on value measures (DSS, SCS); robust to temperature and prompt changes.

G.notes: Only the TCT is coded; AHS, DSS and SCS are questionnaires (not coded in C or E). Table 1 caption says Temp=1 but Methods call baseline temperature 0. TCT has no norm or test, so label is INSUFFICIENT. Robustness rests on a figure I could not read (Figure 1); no snapshot or dates; supplement not in text.
